summary: Phase 10 (SMS Notifications) backend E2E tested against fresh SQLite DB + local mock HTTP server on :9099. 13/15 tests passed, 2 skipped (both are pre-existing environment/API-behavior quirks, not Phase 10 bugs). All critical SMS requirements verified: generic HTTP provider config (no hard-coded provider), encrypted credentials never leaked, 4 seeded templates (TARE_COMPLETED/PAYMENT_COMPLETED × hi/en), template upsert + EventCode/Language validation (rejects LOAN_ISSUED with 400), TCP test-connection 200/409, test-send never echoes raw provider response and never creates SmsLog row, end-to-end Weighment Tare -> SmsLog SENT with all placeholders substituted and mobile masked (98XXXXXX10 pattern), Payment -> PAYMENT_COMPLETED SmsLog SENT, Enabled=false correctly skips queuing (smsQueued=false, no SmsLog row), failure -> RETRY_PENDING with AttemptCount=1 + FailureReason + NextAttemptAt populated, manual /retry -> SENT after fixing endpoint, non-blocking guarantee confirmed (Weighment Tare AND Payment both return HTTP 200 even with unreachable SMS provider), sms-logs list masks mobiles and filters by status/eventCode, Loan module has zero SMS side-effect (no smsQueued field on loan response, no SmsLog row after loan issue).

minor.issue: Empty-mobile grower creation returns 409 'Mobile must be exactly 10 numeric digits' (as expected). This means the 'no mobile number' SMS-skip path cannot be exercised via public API - grower creation itself enforces mobile. Test skipped. Not a Phase 10 bug; noted for context.

Same pre-existing environment quirk noted in prior iterations - freshly created non-Developer users cannot re-login after change-password on this SQLite dev DB. The RBAC 403 test was skipped as a result. Not a Phase 10 issue; author's own iteration_6 note confirms this quirk.

action_items: No blocking action items. Phase 10 SMS module implementation is solid and matches all documented requirements.
Optional: consider allowing RBAC test path in dev by fixing the known non-Developer post-change-password login quirk (out of Phase 10 scope, tracked from earlier iterations).

Optional: add an integration test hook or admin endpoint to directly call ISmsService.QueueAsync twice for the same (EventCode, ReferenceId) to explicitly exercise the DB unique-index idempotency path (currently only indirectly verified by the single-row-per-PUR-<id> assertion after Tare).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/config/sms correctly returns booleans (HasApiKey / HasApiSecret) only - verified no plaintext / encrypted / prefix of the actual secret is ever serialized (grep + explicit assertion in tests).
PUT /api/config/sms: omitting apiKey/apiSecret in the payload correctly preserves the existing encrypted value (verified round-trip).
SmsTemplateController correctly rejects EventCode='LOAN_ISSUED' with 400 and language='fr' with 400. Upsert path verified: editing (TARE_COMPLETED, hi) does not create a 5th row.
TestSendSms only returns {success, message} and never the provider raw JSON body - verified mock's 'MOCK-N' id token is never in the API response.
SmsQueueProcessor 15s cycle behaves as documented; SENT transition observed within ~20s across multiple purchases and one Payment.

Failure -> RETRY_PENDING transition writes AttemptCount, FailureReason, and NextAttemptAt correctly. Manual POST /api/sms-logs/{id}/retry moves NextAttemptAt to now and next cycle transitions to SENT once the config points at a reachable host - end-to-end retry path is working.

Non-blocking guarantee is real: with SmsConfig.ApiBaseUrl pointing at 127.0.0.1:1 (unreachable), BOTH /api/weighment/tare AND /api/payments return HTTP 200 and the Purchase/Payment rows persist correctly - SMS failure never rolls back the parent transaction.
SmsLog.mobileMasked is applied at the API projection layer (SmsLogController) - full mobile is never present in list JSON (verified by explicit substring check on entire response body).

Loan issue path correctly has NO smsQueued field on the response and no SmsLog row is created after POST /api/loans - the Phase 8 module was NOT accidentally coupled to Phase 10 SMS, matching the explicit 'only 2 SMS events' requirement.

Recommendation (nit): the RequestBodyTemplate placeholder set is documented in Configs.cs as '{Mobile} {Message} {ApiKey} {ApiSecret} {SenderId} {EntityId}' - consider surfacing that list in the GET /api/config/sms response (or in a /api/config/sms/placeholders endpoint) so the frontend config UI can render it as help text without reading source.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 executed passed; 2 skipped due to non-Phase-10 environment quirks)

seed_data_creation: Fresh SQLite DB seeded via /tmp/canefactory_dev.db* delete + first run. Test suite is idempotent: creates Zone A / Village A / Rate + a fresh grower per test with unique mobile (TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mock SMS server: python3 /app/backend/tests/mock_sms_server.py 9099. Run tests with: cd /app/backend/tests && python3 -m pytest test_phase10_sms.py -v -n 0. Requires fresh dev DB (rm /tmp/canefactory_dev.db*) OR at minimum developer/DevSecure@2026 already active. Backend port 8001 must be freed from platform supervisor first (`sudo supervisorctl stop backend`) before starting dotnet run. The two skipped tests (no-mobile grower, non-Developer RBAC 403) are pre-existing environment/API constraints, not bugs - do not spend time trying to unstick them.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in Phase 10 SMS implementation. All 10 user-confirmed requirements verified end-to-end against a controllable local HTTP mock.
